required_inputs: role capture stdout JSON for closed mode
CLI: sudo python3 -B OBS --role ROLE --initial-json INITIAL capture
sudo python3 -B OBS --role ROLE --initial-json INITIAL --ready-json CAPTURE closed
write_semantics: No guest writes; caller captures stdout/rc. Capture must be saved before stopping and copied unchanged for closed.
final_four_role_aggregation: require four rc0/PASS, four exact wait0, eight child/supervisor incarnations gone counted as (VM role, PID, starttick), sum allocated_bytes <=1073741824; each backing-volume reserve and immutable protected rows/processes.
limits: Protection is exact initial inventory, not broad grep.
Budget uses frozen helper, excludes mount subtree and never queries R3 FUSE statfs.
Readiness checks executable/cfg and actual supervised process/mount/socket, not Meta logical health/R3 placement (parent/collector owns these).
Reader/coordinator persistent stdio processes are parent-owned; parent must retain actual relay exits separately.
